name: [JANUARY] Corrupted Crossroads
desc:
OUTRUN THE KILLER. MASTER YOUR ABILITIES. SURVIVE.

x1.25 more Coins & XP on the weekends!

Corrupted Crossroads is an asymmetrical survival game featuring fully customizable loadouts for both killers and survivors.
Craft your ultimate build by combining unique class stats, custom abilities, and a diverse selection of deadly blades!

⚠️ This game is in BETA! Expect bugs to arise. You can report them in our community server. ⚠️

This game is inspired by Flee the Facility and several other asymmetrical games.
